speaker: diane_sterling
headline: DELIVERY FAILS WHEN THE TRANSMISSION MECHANISM BREAKS.
deck: Budgets and contracts only matter if capital moves through execution into a usable service.
quote: Measure the chain from allocation to delivery, not the announcement to the headline.
facts: Inputs need a funded, priced delivery path.
Contracts convert budgets into executable obligations.
Services are the measurable output of the chain.
Households feel the final performance result.
takeaway: Economic credibility is the ability to convert allocated resources into repeatable delivery.
